frozen_scientific_question: Can source-specific finite threshold frontiers be decomposed exactly into shortest-hop ambiguity intervals, bounded by directed source-core diameter, and do new independent synthetic topologies produce nonzero source uncertainty budget beyond the fully connected case?

inference_contract.positive_roster: all declared source nodes plus all targets, identical for each source
inference_contract.required_hops_per_source: h_s(theta)=max_{positive p} directed shortest-path-step distance from singleton s to p; infinity if unreachable
inference_contract.gap_width: h_robust-h_possible when h_possible and h_robust finite
inference_contract.core_diameter: D_C=max_{u,v in source nodes} shortest directed source-core distance; infinity if core not strongly connected
inference_contract.proven_bound_if_core_SCC: h_robust-h_possible<=D_C for every theta with finite h_possible
inference_contract.mean_gap_area: sum_{H=0}^{n_nodes-2} g(H)=mean_over_theta(h_robust-h_possible) when core remains SCC and all h finite
inference_contract.status: Finite declared graph/threshold constraints only. Steps are directed graph hops, not generations or years

newly_frozen_generator.generation_method: Copy parent v3 generator configuration exactly except random_seeds=40 to admit only fresh indices 24..39. Invoke parent generate_graph for complete/cycle; derive bidirectional star by replacing only source-source core edges from complete while holding optional and S0 target anchors unchanged. All baseline source core arcs are non-hard with geography 8/env 0/barrier 0.
newly_frozen_generator.priority_hypothesis: G5: cycle-minus-star mean A_g >0 across 64 paired new-source graph draws; hypothesis falsified/not supported if <=0. Do not change seed generator/metric after scoring.
newly_frozen_generator.secondary: complete/star/cycle area profiles, equality/strict sign counts, tightness fraction K(theta)=D_C, nonmonotone g(H) curves, value of independent source edge observations (not attempted)

prespecified_claims.test: For each fixed graph/threshold and source, h_s equals independently computed BFS maximal positive directed distance. For every H=0..n_nodes-1, possible and robust indicators equal min/max hop thresholds.
When source core is strongly connected under baseline and every node is a required positive, K(theta)=h_robust-h_possible is finite, nonnegative and <=D_C; count all 0 violations.

Sum_H g(H) over H=0..n_nodes-2 equals mean_theta K(theta), within machine numerical tolerance; independently compute g(H) from native EOG-v2 source-MRR for predeclared seed24, all source counts/densities/topologies, H1 and Hcritical and Hterminal (3*2*2*3=36 native crosschecks).

Break one cycle core edge S0->S1 without introducing a return edge from target to source. Some theta has h_possible finite but h_robust infinite and no finite D_core; must not falsely assert terminal convergence.
Mean over 64 paired new-seed graphs of A_cycle−A_bidirectional_star is strictly positive; classify result without repairing if not positive.
Count number of independent new panels where g(H) rises at least once before later falling; retain zero if none. Do not treat a monotone g prediction as a theorem.
Same optional-edge digest/threshold world grid across all three topology regimes for paired graph draw, all 64 draws accounted; 0 native mismatches and no EOG-WF endpoint.

stop_rules: Do not score historical Glanville source assignments or site-level responses.
Keep graph-hop horizon distinct from elapsed generations/years; source S only hypothetical.
Do not interpret threshold-world fraction as probability without calibrated prior.
A numerical bound check is theorem verification, not empirical biological replication.
If native EOG mismatch, stop and diagnose rather than change numerator or seed family.
Preserve all 64 paired graphs including zero/negative G5 contrasts and hard disconnection control.
No ecological causal effect, species-specific dispersal estimate or EOG-WF fourth scored endpoint.
